4999325.name: The Gan - Alameda Jewish Preschool
4999325.note: No start year found. Chabad of Alameda's preschool (Mushki Shmotkin): its site as archived Oct 24 2020 already describes 'a Large Family Day Care Home in Alameda' using 'three rooms of a beautiful sun-lit home' overlooking the Alameda lagoon, and speaks of preparing 'to reopen our school' after Covid, so it ran by 2020 (likely before March 2020); Chabad of Alameda itself began in Aug 2017, so not before then. Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 5 2021 (now 1516 Oak Street, #316); the site's domain has since lapsed.

3324345.name: Chabad of Chula Vista
3324345.note: California Secretary of State record (via BizProfile): 'Chabad Of Chula Vista ... Officially filed on May 13, 2016' (document 3907609; filed as Chabad Of Southern Chula Vista, renamed Oct 2018; Rabbi Menachem Begun, CEO). The corporation's filing, not a report of its opening, so medium. Its chabad.org listing was published June 27 2016. Rabbi Mendel and Mushka Katz 'moved here to re-establish Chabad' in 2025 (Instagram) and are now its officers. Its IRS record (ruling Nov 2016, via ProPublica) gives 1910 Harrils Mill Ave.; its state filings now give 2086 Otay Lakes Rd #101.

earlier.where: 1910 Harrils Mill Ave., Chula Vista (the address on its IRS record, Rabbi Menachem Begun's)
